_note: Cities Without Number hacking constants, transcribed from the CWN SRD (CC0). This file is the engine-neutral contract: the Python rules layer (src/rules/cwn_hacking.py) and the Godot kernel (godot/core/cwn_hacking.gd) both read the same numbers, so the two runtimes cannot disagree. No SRD sentence, table or program catalogue is reproduced here.

security_levels.8: small business, minor gang or minor government office
security_levels.9: corp branch office, major gang or important government facility

access_pool.formula: INT modifier + Program rank + the deck's Bonus Access

security_modifiers._note: inside_information_range is a positive magnitude 1..3 that lowers the target, which is the convention src/rules/cwn_hacking.py uses and tests/test_cwn_hacking.py pins (security_difficulty(9, inside_info=3) == 6).
